metadata.name: isaac_agent
metadata.description:
Game-side bridge for the isaac-agent-bridge project: exports state.json, consumes decision.json, and falls back to local rules (heal/damage) when no fresh decision exists. Requires REPENTOGON. No network access, no API key handling.
协议见项目根 docs/protocol.md；本 mod 只读写桥目录内的 JSON，不联网、不读 key、不写注册表。
